K_labels.K_catalogue: shortest verified candidate, every shorter admissible candidate decided
K_labels.K_cert: construction certificate (every (K-1)-subset of movable discs removed leaves the target pick or place certified closed; declared grasp family, monotone collisions)
K_labels.never: K_intent is never evidence; no global-minimality claim

attribution: a positive whole-system X/Y vs DIRECT difference would not isolate the factorization: X/Y arms also use component labels and SYM supervision

endpoints.U_unconditional: repair success over ALL INF roots (roots with no verified candidate count as failures for every arm)
endpoints.unnecessary: false repair (chosen m > 0) over FEA roots; harmful = chosen edit fails

gates.IMPROVES: Holm-rejected two-sided bootstrap test on U with Holm-level interval lower > 0, U point >= 0.10, C 95% CI lower > 0, and unnecessary-repair point increase <= +0.05 (historical P17 / P21 / P22 thresholds, unchanged)
gates.ORDER: O1 / O3 strict-order concordance difference: Holm-rejected with interval lower > 0 (historical 'ORDER_FAVOURS_FIRST', no magnitude threshold); O2 REP34 success: threshold 0.10 + guardrail (P21 H4 replication)
gates.POSITIVE_BELOW_THRESHOLD: as IMPROVES but U point < 0.10 (statistically positive, below the meaningful-effect criterion; not a supported advantage)
gates.SECONDARY_K34: same labels on REP34 conditional success (threshold 0.10, guardrail on FEA)

generator_shift: new seeds of the SAME K34 doorway family + V21B controls: no cross-generator or 3D claim

hierarchy.authoritative_primary: U_unconditional (P17 / P21 / P22 lineage: 'succ_inf'; the P22 'first' endpoint); the headline verdict of each comparison
hierarchy.consistency_requirement: C_availability_conditioned 95% CI lower > 0 is REQUIRED for a positive primary label (no endpoint switching: C cannot rescue a failed U, U is never replaced by C)
descriptive_only: K1-K4 strata with and without certification (Wilson 95%)

missingness.corrupt_row: absent + custody event in the report
missingness.negatives: attempted fixed-budget failures are operational 0 with negative kind CERTIFIED vs NO_PLAN_FOUND / TIMEOUT kept evaluator-side; no impossibility claim from budget failures
missingness.undecided_choice: a chosen candidate with X or Y undecided is NOT a verified success (counted per arm); sensitivity: same tests excluding roots where any arm chose an undecided candidate

models.ensemble: 15-member mean, F1 first, frozen pooled rule per arm; one deterministic predictor per arm

endpoints: unconditional repair success on initially infeasible roots
primary_wording.gate: IMPROVES if CI lower > 0, point >= 0.10 and unnecessary-repair increase <= 0.05
primary_wording.test: paired family bootstrap B = 10000, two-sided 95% CI; Holm across the three comparisons per endpoint

populations.AVAIL: INF with >= 1 teacher-verified candidate in the frozen catalogue
populations.REP34: AVAIL with verified K in {3, 4} (K = shortest verified candidate with every shorter admissible candidate decided)

power.note: P21 per-root values are 3-seed means (sd deflated); a single ensemble gives per-root differences in {-1, 0, 1}, whose sd is about sqrt(disagreement rate) (P21: U 0.42, C 0.64, REP34 0.62 for D vs DIRECT), reported with the 0.3 / 0.5 / 1.0 sensitivity; the P22 0.062 half-width is a projection, not a guarantee

q_ref: q_ref = q0 = scene robot state for every root (adapter refuses otherwise)
reconciliation_with_P22: P22 listed two primary endpoints 'by K stratum' with Holm 'per endpoint': clarified to ONE authoritative endpoint (U, pooled over strata) with C as a required consistency condition; K strata are descriptive (K3 / K4 inferential only via the REP34 secondary family)
P22 did not define the population of the K3/K4 test: fixed as REP34 (P21 H1-H3 definition)
P22 froze D / E / A only: G is added (FROZEN_MODELS_P23_APPEND) with a separate ORDER family
P22 did not record the arms' pooled rules: recorded in FROZEN_MODELS_P23_APPEND, computed by the declared procedure
thresholds (0.10 gain, +0.05 unnecessary, CI lower > 0) are unchanged; Holm is now applied with explicit Holm-level intervals
prediction timing: predictions are computed and sealed (sha256 in the ledger) after the design freeze and BEFORE any teacher label (new, stricter)

references.VERIFY_FIRST_ORACLE: evaluator-only upper bound, cost = teacher verifications; never deployed or described as learned

statistics.bootstrap: paired, unit = root family (one per confirmation root), B = 10000, seed 0, percentile intervals
statistics.multiplicity: Holm step-down at alpha 0.05 within each family; families are separate (primary / K34 secondary / order); 95% intervals also reported
statistics.p_value: two-sided bootstrap p = min(1, 2 min(P*(d <= 0), P*(d >= 0)))
statistics.strict_order: per root: same action multiset, same endpoint, both F1-admissible and observed, X discordant; |dpx| <= 1e-08 scores 0.5; root mean first, roots are the samples (pair x seed counts are never treated as independent)
statistics.ties_in_selection: bxy_p11.choose: lowest cost, then (m, C_d, signature); deterministic

success: a chosen candidate is a success iff the teacher verified it: X = 1 (every relocation in order from q0 with the achieved state carried, then the single connector to q_ref) and Y = 1 (target task from q_ref in the edited scene), with independent replay; for the no-op, Y0 = 1; predicted success never counts
